units: <cite ref="Sotah 35b:12">Sot. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>כי סיד</he> like lime. Y. Yeb. XVI, end, 16ᵃ <he>כי חיה</he> like a lying-in woman; a. fr.
Ex. R. s. 9, beg. (ref. to Ex. VII, 9) … אם ידבר אלא כי וכ׳ it does not read, ‘if Pharaoh …, but when …; he will say so.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 3a:12">R. Hash. 3ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A01111"><he>אִי</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 3:1:2">Y. Ḥag. III, 77ᵇ</cite> <he>וכי היה המעשה</he> and thus it came to pass.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 8:3">Yeb. VIII, 3</cite> <he>לא כי הלכה וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>לא כי אלא וכ׳</he>) it is not so; I am reciting a Halakhah.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 1:4">Shek. I, 4</cite> <he>לא כי אלא וכ׳</he> it is not so, but &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 87b:6">Yoma 87ᵇ</cite> (quoting from a prayer) <he>כי עונותינו וכ׳</he> for our iniquities are &c.

senses.gloss: וְכִי (introducing a question to which a negative answer is expected) is it really so that? R. Hash. 9ᵃ וכי בתשעה … והלא וכ׳ do we fast on the ninth? Is it not the tenth &c.? Sabb. 4ᵃ וכי אומרים וכ׳ dare we say to a man &c.?; Men. 48ᵃ.
